links.outcome: Fine-tuned LLM extraction accuracy on local historical reports against paired structured data and expert annotations
links.effect: 98.7% (69,144/70,032 values) on contemporary YNHHS test set; 87.1% against expert annotations in 100 older YNHHS reports
links.quote: At YNHHS, HeartDX-LM accurately extracted 69 144 of 70 032 values (98.7%) across 18 fields in the contemporary test set where paired structured data were available.

links.outcome: Model performance across external sites (MIMIC-III, MIMIC-IV) versus development site
links.effect: External accuracy 87.9% (615/707) in MIMIC-III and 91.3% (201/220) in MIMIC-IV, versus 98.7% at YNHHS
links.quote: In external validation sets from MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV, HeartDX-LM correctly extracted 615 of 707 available values (87.9%) and 201 of 220 available values (91.3%), from 100 random, expert-annotated reports from each set.

unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning a smaller open-source LLM on synthetic reports generated by a larger LLM to extract structured data from unstructured reports
Determining minimum training set size (500 report-structured data pairs) for consistent extraction performance

screen.reason: Empirical study developing and validating a fine-tuned LLM system (HeartDX-LM) on retrospective echocardiogram reports to extract structured data, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or organizational practice.
